missing_claims.claim: Complete synthesized v1 gel-bead oligo bases are absent from the checked source set
missing_claims.evidence: Two independent readers checked the original article, preprint, all listed supplements, CG00026 Rev B guide and 10x-origin whitelist. The paper prints anchored (T)30VN and barcode members appear in both a published workbook and the whitelist, but no complete synthesized v1 bead-oligo sequence appears in the checked set.

conclusion: Two independent readings cover the article, preprint, all listed supplements, vendor guide and whitelist. Barcode members and UMI variants are printed; a complete synthesized v1 bead oligo was not found in that source set. Linked information was enumerated and followed.
